data.description:
## Context / Problem
`run_bridge` spawns `rebar bridge sync|preview` (`MODE_COMMANDS`, `_bridge_runner.py:26-31`), which spawns the engine via `subprocess.call` with no timeout (`_cli/_bridge_commands.py:51`, `launch_reconciler`, `engine_env`): the hop chain is `_bridge_runner._run(MODE_COMMANDS[profile])` (`:112-123,216`) → `rebar bridge sync` → `launch_reconciler` → `python -m rebar_reconciler sync`. On the 3600 s timeout the runner kills only the middle process; the engine grandchild is orphaned (PPID 1) holding the pass lock until lease expiry. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
1. `MODE_COMMANDS` becomes `MODE_ARGS: Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {"dry-run": ("preview",), "bootstrap-strict": ("sync","--max-changes","10"), "bootstrap-throttle": ("sync","--max-changes","100"), "live": ("sync",)}`; argv = `(sys.executable, "-m", "rebar.reconciler", *MODE_ARGS[profile], "--repo-root", str(root))`.
2. Replace `_run` with `_spawn_bounded(argv, *, root, environ) -> CompletedProcess`: `Popen(..., cwd=root, env=environ, stdin=DEVNULL, stdout=PIPE, stderr=PIPE, text=True, errors="replace", start_new_session=(os.name=="posix"))`, `communicate(timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS)`; on `TimeoutExpired` → `rebar._proc.reap_process_group(proc, grace=_REAP_GRACE_S=10.0, drain=_REAP_DRAIN_S=5.0, label="bridge", logger=logger)` then re-raise so the existing "timed out" branches (`:217-219,260-270`) stay. Use it for the delivery child too (`_delivery_command` `:172-192` unchanged, credential-stripped env unchanged).
3. SIGTERM does not run the engine's `finally`; lock recovery stays with the lease/steal path (`_pass_lock_lifecycle`); no signal handler is added. `launch_reconciler` remains the operator CLI path (`rebar bridge preview|sync`).
4. Exit-code ownership: the engine child (`__main__._finish_disposition`, `:95-113`) is the single owner of canonicalisation for `preview`/`sync`; `_classified_result` (`:154-169`) keeps only the `BRIDGE_STATE:` marker parse for the state name and returns `(state, returncode)` with the child's exit code unchanged; the `legacy_exit` table walk (`:166-168`) is deleted because the runner now only invokes canonical routes. An exit 0 without a marker is `("converged", 0)`; a non-zero exit without a marker is `("operational_failure", rc)` with `rc` propagated verbatim (a child exiting 2 with no marker is `("operational_failure", 2)`, never `invalid_invocation`).
5. `docs/exit-codes.md:37-41` states: "canonical 0/1/2 is produced once, in the engine child, for the `preview`/`sync` routes; `rebar bridge run` propagates the child's exit unchanged and reads `BRIDGE_STATE:`/`BRIDGE_PAUSED:` only for the state name; 3/4/75 survive only on the argument-less direct-engine route." The `docs/user-guide.md` bridge-run section describes the direct spawn.

BREAKING: `rebar bridge run` no longer invokes `rebar bridge sync|preview` as a subprocess; profiles map to engine `preview`/`sync` argv directly.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_bridge_runner.py`, `docs/exit-codes.md:37-59`, `docs/user-guide.md` (bridge run section), `tests/unit/test_bridge_runner*.py` (existing runner tests that assert the `rebar bridge …` argv). Out of scope: `src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py` (`launch_reconciler` stays as the operator path), the engine's own signal handling, and `rebar._proc.reap_process_group` (consumed as-is).

## Testing
Happy: runner unit tests assert argv `[sys.executable, "-m", "rebar.reconciler", "sync", "--repo-root", root]` for `live` and `--max-changes 10` for `bootstrap-strict`; `Popen` called with `start_new_session=True` on POSIX. Edge: monkeypatch `TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1` and spawn a stub `-m` target that itself spawns `sleep 30` (the grandchild) → after `run_bridge` returns `operational_failure`, `os.kill(grandchild_pid, 0)` raises `ProcessLookupError` (`python3 scripts/check_orphaned_load.py` clean); a child exiting non-zero with no marker maps to `("operational_failure", rc)` with `rc` propagated verbatim; a delivery-child timeout still reaps. Commands: `pytest tests/unit/test_bridge_runner*.py -q`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `_bridge_runner.py` contains no `"rebar", "bridge"` argv and no `legacy_exit` reference — grep.
- [ ] Timeout test proves the grandchild is reaped (no PPID-1 survivor) — `pytest tests/unit/test_bridge_runner*.py -q` plus `python3 scripts/check_orphaned_load.py`.
- [ ] `docs/exit-codes.md` states the single owner as specified — grep for "produced once, in the engine child".
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Spawn python -m rebar.reconciler directly from _bridge_runner and reap the process group on timeout
